documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for The Quarter Ended On June 30, 2026.
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive Limited reported strong performance in Q4 and full year FY26 across revenue and profitability, marking the 10th consecutive quarter of robust performance since its listing. Management highlighted that the company outgrew the Indian two-wheeler industry production growth of 11.8% in FY26, driven by value-added business expansion, utilization improvement, cost efficiencies, and independent aftermarket growth following GST rate reductions. Looking ahead to FY27, the company expects mid-teens revenue growth and anticipates contributions from new joint ventures and product lines starting from the second half of the year, while navigating input cost pressures from aluminium prices and wage hikes. ASK Automotive Limited reported its financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting consolidated revenue growth of 16.2% for FY26 and 35.3% for Q4 FY26. Management noted that absolute EBITDA remained strong at Rs.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of continuing to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: All OEM customers are continuing with their original production schedules showing nice growth for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

demand_outlook.claim: The independent aftermarket grew by 24.7% in FY26, supported by the reduction of GST from 28% to 18%.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

capex_expansion.claim: For next year's growth of mid-teens, the company needs to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for FY26 was Rs. 551 Cr with a margin of 13.1%, which was impacted by pass-through alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.

margins_costs.claim: Aluminium price volatility and denominator effects affected EBITDA margins during Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: As already shared in the previous con-call that our EBITDA margin gets affected due to volatility in the aluminium prices because of the denominator effects.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year FY26, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 40 bps without the impact of passthrough alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: But for this impact EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 40 bps.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Bengaluru plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company while containing debt levels within limits.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia have disrupted the global economy, causing volatility in energy, commodities, and currency.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export revenue declined to Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 due to trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, and logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: Alloy wheel supplies to the Japanese customer will begin in the beginning of H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The alloy wheel supplies to the Japanese customer in the beginning of the H2, so this current year you'll see much higher capacity utilization in the Karoli plant also.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects revenue of around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr from alloy wheels in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

management_commitments.claim: The company will be spending about Rs. 400 Cr on capex in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

management_commitments.claim: Supplies from the cable JV and sunroof ventures are expected to start in H2.
management_commitments.quote: GTD cable holding, the production has come out and to the system suppliers have audited the plant and the supplies again will start in H2.

management_commitments.claim: With effect from April 1, 2026, wheel assembly sales will be nil.
management_commitments.quote: With effect from 01.04.2026, WA sales will be Nil

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
